<div class="card-body">
'''Owen Lars''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Owen Lars]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4076). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オーウェン・ラーズ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「ラーズ家のモイスチャー・ファーム」へ配備するのなら配備コスト不要。「ベルー・ラーズ」か「ヴァーポレーター」と同じ位置カードにいれば、戦闘力＋２。相手のターンにロストデッキへ行った場合、次の自分のターンが終了するまで、ルークの戦闘力に＋３。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-owen-lars-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルーク・スカイウォーカーの保護者。ベルー・ラーズの夫でオビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟。モイスチャー・ファームの所有者。タトゥイーンを離れたいというルークに難色を示した。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Owen Lars.

'''Card text:''' Deploys for free to [[Lars' Moisture Farm|Lars' Moisture Farm]]. Power +2 at the same site card as [[Beru Lars|Beru Lars]] or a [[Vaporator|Vaporator]]. If he goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

'''Lore:''' [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian, [[Beru Lars|Beru Lars]]'s husband, and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s younger brother. Owner of a moisture farm. He objected to Luke's wish to leave Tatooine.
